row:
With more than 60 undergraduate and graduate programs, the Bouvé College of Health Sciences offers students extraordinary opportunities in four preeminent schools:  Community Health and Behavioral Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, and Clinical and Rehabilitation Sciences. United across disciplines - preparing the next generation of highly skilled, versatile, and enterprising health care leaders, while advancing high-impact research to address the world’s challenging issues.

Learn more about Bouvé’s inter-professional classroom approaches, Simulation exercises that prepare students for real-life crises, state-of-the-art facilities that foster high-impact research, student and faculty spotlights, and so much more. 

Welcome to Bouvé College. Redefining what's possible in healthcare and health sciences.
Find us on social @NUBouve
